data.one_liner: Additional ready-made form input fields for the flutter_form_builder package
data.what_it_does: Provides common ready-made input fields such as color pickers, rating bars, searchable dropdowns, signature pads, and touch spin numbers that integrate directly with flutter_form_builder.
use_when: You are already using flutter_form_builder in your app
You need specialized form inputs like signature pads, color pickers, or searchable dropdowns
avoid_when: You are not using the flutter_form_builder package
You only need standard text fields and basic checkboxes
strengths: Saves time by providing pre-built integrations for popular ecosystem packages as form fields
Supports common validation, initial values, and decorations out of the box
weaknesses: Relies heavily on external third-party dependencies for each individual field type
Version upgrades can bring breaking changes from underlying packages
data.setup_notes: No specific setup required: only install the dependency and use.
